head: c4a56d9a4238dcb6c489d0a0fe09037ba4024f3b
scope: Only the 23-path correction delta; prior production, original-runtime and backend source reviews reused. Combined correctness, clean-code, boundary and test-meaningfulness review.
disposition: Four prior shipping P2 findings resolved by source inspection. Grouped P3 partially resolved; one new fixture P2 and a residual/new documentation P3 need bounded correction. No new shipping arithmetic, memory, ABI, lifetime or authority defect established. Candidate runtime acceptance pending.

findings.title: Reuse the actual loaded season for the face probe
findings.mechanism: Boot has already invoked the shared lazy reference provider with the actual native loaded-map season. The later explicit winter=false map request contradicts a valid winter session, causing seasonal_provider to refuse at terrain.rs:580-583 before terrain_face_probe runs. This is a test-driver defect, not a shipping season-transport defect.
findings.bounded_correction: Capture the actual request season/map facts through the boot provider wrapper, then use those facts for the centre; do not force Summer or weaken the one-season provider guard.
findings.validation: A real-script control with a winter first request should reach the face-probe call; reference and generic no-hint modes remain required. No reviewer execution performed.

findings.title: Retain the actual DLL 2D loader/grid coupling in the diagnostic description
findings.mechanism: New text says headless boot never calls load_2d_terrain and does not load the DLL grid. Actual eech_engine.c:250 calls load_3d_terrain_game_data, and aphavoc/source/ui_menu/czone/zone_sc.c:245 calls load_2d_terrain(session->data_path). Original missing-grid generation is also retained evidence of that path. The new wording obscures remaining G2 coupling and can misclassify available= diagnostics.
findings.bounded_correction: Restore the explicit transitional DLL 2D load/generation description. Keep the correct distinction between the client cache and the excluded original numerical solver, and between physical tuples and fast-hit-dependent fold hashes. No raw evidence or oracle change is needed.

prior_findings.evidence: Original coastline neighbour order and in-place reads retained, copied line intersection arithmetic matches vector.c after removing debug assertions/comments, coastal path iteration and final remaining -5000 to -2 normalization present. River files are host-read with checked lengths/node references; borrowed buffers expire only after generation. All-map lock covers open/generation. Snapshot writes checked owned bytes. New synthetic coastline/malformed-file tests and full terrain.sim comparison target the original deficiency.

Real terrain_callback matches operation and TerrainAnswer variant before writing reply_out. New tests call that production callback for all six wrong pairings with sentinels, all three correct variants and season/refusal transport.

prior_findings.status: shipping source-resolved; new fixture issue separately recorded
prior_findings.evidence: Native session/map-info selection precedes terrain loading. winter=true is an optional override; false preserves native selection. First C terrain request captures that season and all requests carry it; lazy provider holds the map season across later CHC tags. Winter files require both default-W.sec/default-W.rgb; otherwise default pair. Actual factory tests exercise both seasons, pair fallback and wrong/later season refusal.

stored bool is distinct from optional hint throughout C/Rust/Lua. Nil Lua stored defaults true; wrong types refuse. Reference derives original record face state, client retains sticky true until clear, including subsequent no-face/Cuba behavior; generic no-hint answers can preserve fixed-wing face predicate. C fixture invokes real client queries and restores shared state on healthy completion.

Fast-hit word makes primed/run folds incomparable and symbol ownership no longer requires blanket absence of system_point_data. The new incorrect no-2D-load assertion remains as HEADLESS_2D_GRID_WORDING.

boundary_and_safety: C/Rust repr(C) request winter, reply stored, host RawAnswer stored and engine config winter field order/type agree by inspection, including normal C alignment on 32-bit; no new private pointer or identity crosses the provider boundary.

River node/path slices remain live for the C open call, parsed storage is private and freed after generation; generated grid stays map-owned. Supplied grid remains Rust-owned and live with Terrain. Snapshot bounds derive from checked grid dimensions.

Coastal generation and query run under serialized global solver context. Postprocessing introduces no campaign RNG and keeps original float expressions/order. No missing-provider or old-solver fallback was introduced.

Policy, routing, suitability, consequences and accepted D2 behavior remain outside this delta. DLL 2D terrain data/generation and remaining G2/G3/environment/time are still D3 work; no whole-D3 completion inferred.

checks_and_limits.reviewer_actions: Pinned Git source/diff reads, read-only normalized arithmetic comparison and source hashing only. No builds, compiler/preprocessor/tests, Lua execution, campaign/native launch, delegation, source edits or remote writes.
